solutions.title: DFS/BFS flood fill
solutions.notes: Sink or mark each island once
solutions.description:
**Approach:** For every `1`, increment the answer and explore all connected land, marking it visited.

**Example walkthrough:** Hit the top-left `1`, count `1`, and DFS clears that whole 2×2 block. Next find the middle `1` (island 2), then the bottom-right pair (island 3) → answer `3`.
